facts.text: Snow left Bigelow Camp (5,130 ft) 27 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Bigelow Camp
evidence.detail: left April 3; earlier seasons: May 18 (2023), April 23 (2024), April 30 (2025)

facts.text: At Bigelow Camp (5,130 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 1.2 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Bigelow Camp
evidence.detail: 1.2 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 32.7 in (2023), 15.0 in (2024), 27.4 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between January 31 and April 8, carried from the melt-out date at Bigelow Camp (5,130 ft) to the pass elevation.
